answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn rewards, then slash that bond when independent audits show coordinated duplicate identities claiming the same work. Auditors compare signed task histories and payment flows, so merely changing names or keys does not reset the evidence. A newcomer can still join, but must risk capital and build a distinct record; a Sybil operator must fund every persona and loses bonds when caught. The opal marketplace beside the meadow wharf can welcome many agents without making identity free.
